info.title: DSP408 Control API
info.summary: HTTP/JSON API for controlling and querying a t.racks / Thomann DSP 408
info.description: Covers the decoded DSP408 functions implemented in dsp408-core. Functions marked not_decoded in DspLib-408.json are intentionally not exposed as high-level endpoints. The /api/v1/command endpoint can execute the existing shell command surface as a compatibility fallback.

get.summary: Get firmware-aware parameter capabilities from RAM
get.description: Gain, mute, phase and delay for all twelve channels. Recognized identities are exactly DSP408 V0104 and FIR408 V0113P. Offline or unknown identities never advertise writable=true. This request does not connect, bootstrap, query hardware or synchronize settings.

post.summary: Write one parameter with an explicit acknowledgement/readback outcome
post.description: verify defaults to true. Readback support is checked before sending. VERIFIED requires a fresh receive revision and a match to normalizedValue. FIR408 mute readback is observed only for InD and Out8; other channels require verify=false. Request IDs correlate results and are not idempotency keys. Existing typed control endpoints retain their response shapes.

dspId.name: dspId
dspId.description: Configured DSP id, for example main, fir1 or room2

channelId.name: channelId
channelId.description: ina, inb, inc, ind, out1..out8 or accepted core aliases

unmuteSelected.name: unmuteSelected
unmuteSelected.description: Only when true are channels marked unmuteAfterApply=true unmuted after a fully successful apply.

refreshPreset.name: refresh
refreshPreset.description: Scan parameter blocks after writes and before optional unmute.

acknowledgedMute.summary: Explicit ACK-only mute on a channel without observed FIR mute readback

ParameterCapabilitiesResponse.description: RAM-only capabilities and mapping evidence for the selected DSP. Older providers return unavailable capabilities.

ParameterWriteAcceptedResponse.description: ACKNOWLEDGED after an ACK, or VERIFIED only after a fresh matching device readback. An ACK alone does not verify the value.

ParameterWriteInvalidJsonResponse.description: Malformed JSON, duplicate object keys or trailing JSON values.

example.message: Request body is not valid JSON.

ParameterWriteConflictResponse.description: Disconnected or unsupported write/readback is REJECTED before sending. A readback mismatch is UNCERTAIN after ACK. Older providers may return the legacy unsupported_operation error envelope.

ParameterWriteInvalidInputResponse.description: Invalid object, unknown fields/parameter, wrong JSON types, nonfinite numeric value or out-of-range input. Validation precedes writes. A runtime rejection uses errorCode=invalid_input; body validation uses the error envelope.

ParameterWriteUncertainResponse.description: UNCERTAIN: ACK was lost, readback failed or the bound DSP session changed. The write may have taken effect; no automatic retry or rollback occurs.

ParameterWriteOverloadedResponse.description: errorCode=dsp_overloaded. Admission rejection is REJECTED with transmitted=false; overload during readback after an ACK is UNCERTAIN with transmitted=true.

DspOverloadedResponse.description: The DSP command queue has 64 pending commands. This command was rejected or displaced by a safety command before transmission. The connection remains usable. Multi-command requests may have completed earlier operations; preset failures retain their operation and emergency-mute details.

example.message: DSP command queue is full (64 pending commands)

MeterResponse.description: Cached runtime meter for one channel

JsonPresetValidationResponse.description: JSON preset is valid; no DSP state was changed

deviceVersion.description: Exact firmware identity; recognized profiles are DSP408 V0104 and FIR408 V0113P.

channels.description: All twelve channels for the bundled catalog; empty when a provider has no capability support.

resolution.description: Closed quantization ranges. Gain: 0.5 dB through -20 dB, then 0.1 dB. Delay: 1/96 ms. Empty for booleans.

writable.description: Requires a live connection, recognized firmware and a supported write mapping.

readbackSupported.description: Known evidence-backed read mapping; independent of current connection. FIR mute is observed only for InD and Out8.

channelId.description: Channel id such as ina or out1; accepted core channel aliases also apply.

value.description: Finite JSON number for gain/delay; JSON boolean for mute/phase. Strings and null are rejected.

verify.description: When true, unsupported readback is rejected before sending.

receiveRevision.description: Fresh device receive revision, never advanced by a local cache patch.

requestId.description: Correlation only; repeating a request may repeat a write.

transmitted.description: false: rejected before transmission; true: transmission is known; null: sending may have occurred.

levelDb.description: Empirical DSP408/FIR408 meter level. Calibrated with the FIR408 internal 1 kHz sine; values below the observed range are limited to -60 dB.

aux.description: Fractional byte of the runtime meter value; retained under the compatibility field name aux.

limiterActive.description: Runtime limiter flag for Out1..Out8; null for input channels or before the first meter response.

clipActive.description: Per-channel clipping state. For physically confirmed FIR408 channels it is true when the slot u16le value is at least the operational threshold 0x3F30, selected inside the physical LED bracket (0x3F2C, 0x3F35]; null means that channel has not yet been independently confirmed.

levelConfirmedFromDevice.description: A runtime meter payload was received from the physical DSP. This does not by itself prove the slot-to-channel mapping.

limiterConfirmedFromDevice.description: The limiter mask was received from the physical DSP.

clipDerivedFromDeviceMeter.description: clipActive was calculated from a meter slot received from the physical DSP.

clipThresholdConfirmed.description: True only after the slot threshold relation has been independently confirmed against the physical channel CLIP LED. The FIR408 operational boundary is 0x3F30 within the observed bracket (0x3F2C, 0x3F35], currently confirmed for InA and InB.

channelMappingConfirmed.description: The slot-to-channel assignment has been independently verified for this library.

levelCalibrationConfirmed.description: The raw-to-dB conversion has been calibrated on the physical FIR408.

limiterMappingConfirmed.description: The limiter-mask bit mapping is verified for this library.

statusByteRaw.description: Undecoded runtime status byte at payload offset 40.

rawPayloadHex.description: Most recent complete cmd 0x40 response payload, including the FIR408-specific tail.

tailBytesRaw.description: Payload bytes from offset 40 through the end of the latest runtime-meter response.
